name: 77619 · Groves, TX
findings: ZIP 77619 (Groves) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77619 (Groves) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77619 (Groves) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
